         1                 P R O C E E D I N G S

         2                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

         3       The Senate will please come to order.

         4                  I ask everyone present to rise and

         5       recite with me the Pledge of Allegiance to our

         6       Flag.

         7                  (Whereupon, the assemblage recited

         8       the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

         9                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        10       In the absence of clergy, may we all bow our

        11       heads for a moment of silence.

        12                  (Whereupon, the assemblage

        13       respected a moment of silence.)

        14                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        15       Thank you.

        16                  Senator Smith.

        17                  SENATOR SMITH:    Yes, good

        18       afternoon, Madam President.  I'd like to ask,

        19       is there a proclamation by the Governor at the

        20       desk?

        21                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        22       Yes, Senator Smith, there is a proclamation

        23       here at the desk.

        24                  The Secretary will read.

         1                  THE SECRETARY:    "Pursuant to the

         2       power vested in me by Article IV, Section 3 of

         3       the Constitution, I hereby convene the Senate

         4       of the State of New York in Extraordinary

         5       Session, at the Capitol, in the City of

         6       Albany, on the eighth day of July,

         7       two thousand nine, at three o'clock p.m., for

         8       the purpose of considering legislation I will

         9       submit with respect to various subjects, and

        10       acting on gubernatorial nominations.

        11                  "Given under my hand and the Privy

        12       Seal of the State in the City of Albany this

        13       seventh day of July in the year two thousand

        14       nine, by the Governor, David A. Paterson."

        15                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        16       The proclamation having been read, the Senate

        17       is in extraordinary session.

        18                  Senator Smith.

        19                  SENATOR SMITH:    Yes, Madam

        20       President.  Would you please recognize Senator

        21       Dean Skelos.

        22                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        23       Certainly.

        24                  Senator Skelos.



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1                  SENATOR SKELOS:    Senator

         2       Stewart-Cousins.  Do you know anything

         3       about -- are you going to be Lieutenant

         4       Governor later today, or --

         5                  (Laughter.)

         6                  SENATOR SKELOS:    -- is there

         7       anything you'd like to mention to all your

         8       colleagues here?

         9                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        10       Senator Skelos, this is different from the

        11       exchanges we usually have.

        12                  (Laughter.)

        13                  SENATOR SKELOS:    Unfortunately, I

        14       just can't say ditto, but I have to read this

        15       statement as I have in the past.

        16                  And, you know, we convened this

        17       extraordinary session at the Governor's

        18       request, and in keeping with the decision of

        19       the court that we have to convene as a body.

        20       The designation of a presiding officer should

        21       be made by Senator Espada or myself, pursuant

        22       to the vote which took place on June 8th.

        23       Therefore, we do not recognize that you are

        24       the appropriately designated presiding



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       officer.

         2                  Therefore, I ask that the agenda be

         3       laid aside, and I move that the Senate adjourn

         4       this special session sine die.

         5                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

         6       Thank you, Senator.

         7                  Senator Smith.

         8                  SENATOR SMITH:    Thank you very

         9       much, Madam President.

        10                  Given that we are not going to be

        11       taking up any legislative activity, I ask that

        12       we will adjourn this 17th extraordinary

        13       session sine die.

        14                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        15       Thank you, Senator Smith.

        16                  On motion of Senator Smith, the

        17       17th extraordinary session is adjourned

        18       sine die.

        19                  (Whereupon, at 3:09 p.m., the

        20       Senate adjourned.)
